why: Makes sidestepAroundBlockage always report 'the whole wheel is blocked', so dangerAvoidMove's `?? preferred` fallback fires even when a navigable heading exists -- issue #224 AC3's exact defect, reintroduced. Measured at 2 of 107 scoped tests failing, both in the same corridor shape (north/south walled inside the horizon, east/west open): 'sidesteps onto a navigable heading when BOTH perpendiculars are walled' and 'refuses a sidestep candidate that steps toward an armed mine'. Both fixtures have a real navigable answer that this mutation discards, so the returned direction becomes the wall-blocked `preferred` heading in each case, failing their wallBlocksPath(..., dir!, AI_PATH_HORIZON_TICKS) === false assertions.
